usage_definition: One ephemeral native user turn: exactly one turn.completed with its own nonnegative integer input_tokens, cached_input_tokens and output_tokens, cached_input_tokens<=input_tokens, together with complete saved usage. Never reuse earlier turn usage for a missing final usage.
evidence_binding: The final eligible source inventory must equal the actually graded source inventory byte for byte; restored hidden tests must match frozen fixture text under the reused writer; original normal/-O terminal result and failure/error/skip counts must match saved grades; successful threads require nonempty string identities.
gate: All10 original fixed slots accepted in normal and -O grading, successful CLI and final turn.completed, actual full frozen rule body output, complete usage, unique threads, unchanged frozen inputs/methods, retained raw evidence and no confirmed emitted-trace scope violation
execution_policy: No replacement native calls after failures, no model/provider changes, timeouts and API errors remain failures, missing usage stays null. Actual provider exhaustion stops queued calls without purchases or credential changes. Checkpoint-only recovery may grade an existing completed client without starting another model.
transport: Reuse the unchanged existing OS-loopback proxy/MXC helper from the closed v6 batch; no saved settings, authentication, ACL or TLS changes
controls: All6 cases must show initial failure and reference pass with nonzero identical test counts in normal and -O before native calls. New d13/d14 also reject direct rollback to the original pre-maintenance implementation.
artifact_review: Parent reviews all6 new-case patches for implementation and test gaps; fixture-author forward checks are reference-aware known development work, not blinded generalization review.
